description:
As an Applied R&D Engineer, you will be part of the Event Driven Automation (EDA) backend group, working on the development and improvement of application software. Your focus will be on creating robust applications with eventual consistency, optimizing on-change streaming APIs, and contributing to Nokia's data center networking controller. This role offers an opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and a close-knit team.
 NIDC 2026

 Develop application software in C++ and Golang for Kubernetes microservices environment
 Design and optimize on-change streaming APIs for memory, speed, and latency efficiency
 Create robust applications that can function under adverse conditions with eventual consistency
 Collaborate with a talented team of engineers and developers
 Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies
 Ensure code quality and maintainability through best practices
 Document and communicate technical designs and decisions
 Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback
 Troubleshoot and resolve complex software issues
 
 BSCS or a similar degree is required, with work experience in related fields being an advantage
 Advanced knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including kernel operations, scheduling, and memory management
 Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, with the ability to analyze performance
 Experience with software development on Linux platforms
 Excellent programming skills in C/C++ are preferred
 Familiarity with virtualization technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization is a plus
 Knowledge of complex software design for distributed systems in cloud or Kubernetes environments
 Experience working with databases and understanding of database management
 Proficiency in parsing and auto-complete techniques, such as recursive descent
 Ability to interact with management interfaces like gNMI, NETCONF, and REST
 
 
 Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 


 
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.  



 
 Learn more about life at Nokia .


 
 



 
 



 
 Our recruitment process 

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.  Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
